## F30A plan review occurrence

`rebar review-plan herby-crude-rat` failed before model execution at code revision `e48142648445e6f947e46183a99097bfdbc45366` while concurrent sessions were using the shared tracker. Git reported `cannot lock ref refs/remotes/origin/tickets`. The ref was at `5af5cd45e715aaea8498224b75eb9c8118d73bcf` while the fetch expected `4d700f875bf1303bf6642fe0612d6d0013b77a00`.

## Rebar-debug orientation

- Step 0(a). An all-status symptom search and the open bug list identify this ticket as the existing report. No duplicate was created.
- Step 0(b). The occurrence was reported against `e48142648445e6f947e46183a99097bfdbc45366`.
- Step 0(c). A fresh debug worktree at `e48142648445e6f947e46183a99097bfdbc45366` matched `origin/main`.

## Disposition

The current and expected ref pattern matches the dynamic mechanism and controlled parallel versus serialized proof already recorded on this ticket. This occurrence adds production evidence from F30A. It does not identify a different cause. The documentation epic will continue without treating a retry as a fix.
